faq: Do I need a technical background to use this?

No. We write everything in everyday words and explain any technical term the first time it appears. You only need to know who the product is for and what problem it should solve. We help with the rest during the call.
Will you build the product afterwards?
If you want, yes. The scope is written so we or any other developer can quote from it. There is no obligation to build with us, and the document is yours to keep and share.
Can you tell me if my idea will make money?
We cannot predict revenue. We can point out risks, simpler ways to test demand and which features to leave out of version one so you spend less before you learn anything.
What do you need from me before the call?
A few sentences about the idea, who would use it, and any similar products you like or dislike. Sketches or notes are welcome but not required. We send a short question list the day you order.
